scoring_justification: Checker recomputes critical point and coherent spinodal from the model, verifies tie-line equilibrium conditions using the free energy derivatives, and checks structural trends (miscibility gap vs Pi direction) – all from the public equations.

hidden_assets.purpose: Tolerances, expected parameter sets, and structural expectations for phase diagram scoring.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived entirely from the free energy model and expected numerical precision of a correct solver.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Analytic; tolerances set to absorb legitimate implementation spread while rejecting grossly incorrect values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The tolerances and sign expectations are not arbitrary – they reflect the paper's equations and the published trends (gap vs Pi sign depends on ηcc).
